name: @kitr/web
description: @kitr/web: the web platform. mode static, spa or ssr, optional PWA; owns the Vite dev server, build, prerendering and the production server.

kitr.name: web
kitr.title: Web
kitr.summary: Ship to the browser as a static site, a single-page app or a server-rendered app, installable if you want.

platform.label: SSR · SPA · PWA
platform.tagline: Static sites, single-page apps and server-rendered apps, all from the same app folder. Installable as a PWA with one option.

highlights.title: Three rendering modes, one option
highlights.text: `static` prerenders every route to HTML, `spa` serves one shell with client routing, and `ssr` renders on request through TanStack Start. Switch with `kitr config site mode ssr`.

highlights.title: Installable when you want it
highlights.text: `pwa: true` adds the web manifest and a service worker. `useInstallPrompt` and `useServiceWorker` from `@kitr/web/client` show the install button and the update banner.

highlights.title: Search engines read it
highlights.text: `kitr add seo` writes `config/seo.ts`: page heads, share previews, the prerender list, the sitemap and `robots.txt` come from that one file.

highlights.title: As many sites as you need
highlights.text: A marketing site, an app and an admin panel are three named web platforms in one project, each with its own mode and port.

run: Vite with hot reload on port 3000
dist/site/client, plus dist/site/server/server.js in ssr mode
